cold_start.personal_en: The first months, when there's too little data for reliable conclusions. Shown as a grey zone and excluded from calculations.
cold_start.professional_en: Boundary set by `trim_cold_start`: if the first year has a gap > 1 month, history starts after it. Written to `time_series_meta.parquet` as `first_post_gap_month`. Detectors and Variability start after this point.

storm_episodes.personal_en: Periods when your sound profile shifted faster than usual. Shown as a shaded overlay.
storm_episodes.professional_en: Rolling std (3-month centered window) over 4 audio features, threshold `median + 1.5·MAD`. Episode = ≥3 storm months within ≤5 months. Direction of change is not fixed.

shift_sound.personal_en: A month where your overall sound profile shifted noticeably.
shift_sound.professional_en: PELT-A over 6 audio features, monthly median, BIC penalty, bootstrap ≥10%. Base: valid after `trim_cold_start`. Direction of change is not fixed.

shift_behavior.personal_en: A month where your listening habits changed — volume, skips, returns, obsessions.
shift_behavior.professional_en: PELT-B over 6 behavioral features (4 smoothed with rolling 3 months), same parameters as PELT-A. Base: all events after `trim_cold_start`. Direction is not fixed.

shift_identity.personal_en: A month where the set of artists you listen to changed.
shift_identity.professional_en: Cosine distance between artist sets of adjacent months, peaks via `median + 2·MAD`. Base: all events after `trim_cold_start`. Not computed on genres — too inert.
